versions.subject: Windows Redcannay
versions.detection:
selection_cmdlet:
    ScriptBlockText|contains: 
        - 'New-ScheduledTaskAction'
        - 'New-ScheduledTaskTrigger'
        - 'New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal'
        - 'New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet'
        - 'New-ScheduledTask'
        - 'Register-ScheduledTask'
selection_cimmethod:
    ScriptBlockText|contains|all:
        - 'Invoke-CimMethod'
        - '-ClassName'
        - 'PS_ScheduledTask'
        - '-NameSpace'
        - 'Root\Microsoft\Windows\TaskScheduler'
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: ScriptBlockText IN ("*New-ScheduledTaskAction*", "*New-ScheduledTaskTrigger*", "*New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal*", "*New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet*", "*New-ScheduledTask*", "*Register-ScheduledTask*") OR (ScriptBlockText="*Invoke-CimMethod*" ScriptBlockText="*-ClassName*" ScriptBlockText="*PS_ScheduledTask*" ScriptBlockText="*-NameSpace*" ScriptBlockText="*Root\\Microsoft\\Windows\\TaskScheduler*")
